process: Cross-module Fit-Gap examples (FI / SD / MM / PP / HR / PM)

rows.sap_standard_behavior: Standard period-close does not require a multi-level approval workflow.
rows.requirement: CFO sign-off required before period close per internal SOX policy; standard workflow does not support multi-level approval with delegation.
rows.notes: Gap Type: Workflow. Route to wricef-workflow FS. Business Impact: audit finding if period closed without CFO approval.

rows.process_step: Delivery scheduling with customer-specific lead time
rows.sap_standard_behavior: Route determination in SD supports configurable lead times per shipping condition.
rows.requirement: 48-hour lead time buffer per customer SLA.
rows.notes: Configurable via route determination — no delta. Document config values in backlog.

rows.process_step: Physical inventory count via mobile device
rows.sap_standard_behavior: SAP standard MI01/MI07 supports mobile inventory counting via Fiori app.
rows.requirement: Warehouse staff to count inventory using handheld devices.
rows.notes: Standard Fiori apps cover this requirement fully.

rows.sap_standard_behavior: SAP standard supports manual production confirmation via PP transactions.
rows.requirement: Real-time production confirmation from legacy MES system; no manual re-entry.
rows.notes: Gap Type: Interface. Route to business-scenario-design + integration spec (SAP Integration Suite CPI). Business Impact: production data mismatch between MES and SAP if not integrated.

rows.sap_standard_behavior: Standard CO-PA provides profitability analysis but not in the Board-mandated P&L format.
rows.requirement: Board-mandated P&L format by product line differs from standard CO-PA output layout.
rows.notes: Gap Type: Report. Route to wricef-report FS. Business Impact: Board cannot use standard report for decision-making.

rows.sap_standard_behavior: Standard HR payroll supports overtime but regional Labour Code requires specific calculation rules not covered by standard PCR/CAP schemas.
rows.requirement: Regional Labour Code overtime rules: first 2 hours at 1.5x rate, subsequent hours at 2x rate with daily cap.
rows.notes: Gap Type: Legal. Assess SAP Localisation Hub first. If not covered, route to wricef-enhancement-simple FS (PCR modification). Business Impact: non-compliance with Labour Code audit.

rows.process_step: Preventive maintenance plan migration from CMMS
rows.sap_standard_behavior: SAP PM supports preventive maintenance plans but legacy CMMS data structure differs.
rows.requirement: 10 years of maintenance history plus ongoing sync with legacy CMMS during parallel run.
rows.notes: Resolution not yet agreed. Options: one-time migration via LSMW + manual ongoing, or interface via CPI. Escalate to Delta Design Workshop.

rows.sap_standard_behavior: SAP standard output uses SAPscript/Smart Forms for billing output; does not match corporate branding.
rows.requirement: Corporate branding standard requires custom invoice layout with logo, specific font, and footer text.
rows.notes: Gap Type: Print Form. Route to wricef-print-form FS (Adobe Forms). Business Impact: non-compliant customer communication.

rows.process_step: VAT e-reporting to tax authority portal
rows.sap_standard_behavior: SAP standard does not include country-specific e-invoicing for this jurisdiction out of the box.
rows.requirement: Quarterly VAT filing to national tax authority portal via electronic submission.
rows.notes: Gap Type: Legal. Assess SAP DRC / SAP Localisation Hub FIRST before any custom development is commissioned. May be covered by standard localisation content.

rows.sap_standard_behavior: Standard credit management logs overrides but does not send real-time notifications to credit manager.
rows.requirement: Credit manager must receive a real-time notification when a sales rep overrides a credit block.
rows.notes: Gap Type: Workflow. Addressable via BAdI in credit management (released API). Route to wricef-enhancement-simple FS. Business Impact: credit exposure not monitored in real time.
